options.counterfactual: The central-extension filtration used to detect the proposed witnesses does not have the claimed commutator bounds. Consequently, the detector does not prove strictness in every degree c ≥ 3.
options.approach: Audit the commutator bounds directly using lifted elementary matrices, concentrating on opposite-root pairs. Look for a surviving central factor when the sum of the input depths exceeds the claimed nilpotency bound.

options.approach: Check the exact integral statement behind the claimed degree-two injectivity theorem. Distinguish integral injectivity from rational injectivity and distinguish the lower-central graded group from the Andreadakis graded group.

options.approach: Trace the construction from the action on the abelianization of the infinite cyclic cover through determinant balancing and the stable Steinberg extension. Check separately that every map is a homomorphism and that all lifting ambiguities vanish.
